item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 14/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring very hot weather to Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, there will still be a few showers over the region. Winds will be weak over Guangdong in the latter part of this week, it will be extremely hot over inland areas. A broad area of low pressure is expected to develop gradually over the seas east of the Philippines, and edge closer to the vicinity of Luzon in the latter part of this week. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement.
